title: Difference Between Ones and Zeros in Row and Column
description:
You are given a 0-indexed binary matrix grid of size m × n.

Definitions

For each row i and column j:

onesRow[i] = number of 1s in row i
zerosRow[i] = number of 0s in row i
onesCol[j] = number of 1s in column j
zerosCol[j] = number of 0s in column j
Formula

For each cell (i, j), define:

diff[i][j] = onesRow[i] + onesCol[j] - zerosRow[i] - zerosCol[j]
Task

Return the resulting matrix diff.

Examples

Example 1
Input:

[[0,1,1],
 [1,0,1],
 [0,0,1]]

Output:

[[0,0,4],
 [0,0,4],
 [-2,-2,2]]

Example 2
Input:

[[1,1,1],
 [1,1,1]]

Output:

[[5,5,5],
 [5,5,5]]
Constraints
1 ≤ m, n ≤ 10⁵
1 ≤ m × n ≤ 10⁵
grid[i][j] ∈ {0,1}
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
